## Rule

Input is a set of noisy solid-color **bands** (either horizontal or vertical). Output is the
ordered list of distinct band colors: a **1×K row** for vertical bands (colors progress
left→right), or a **K×1 column** for horizontal bands (colors progress top→bottom). K∈{3,4}
observed. The network still emits the standard `[1,10,30,30]` tensor; only the top-left K cells
carry the answer, all other cells stay 0 (decoder trims them).

## Algorithm sketch (LIVE 389-byte graph, Vamshi — decoded 2026-07-03 by bo_ng_cld_worker3)

```
score[c] = Einsum('nchw,h,w->nc', input, row_decay, col_decay)   # geometric decays; ranks
                                                                 # colors by earliest top-left mass
top_values, top_indices = TopK(score, k=4, axis=1)               # band ORDER, directly
orient = Less(Einsum('ni,i->n', top_values, orient_coeff), 0)    # orientation from score magnitudes
seq = OneHot(top_indices, 10, axis=1)                            # [1,10,4] slot->color router
present = Greater(top_values, 0)                                 # mask absent slots
# ONE factorized Einsum paints all 4 colors into the 30x30x10 canvas, orientation-gated by
# 5 terms (3 shared + 1 row + 1 col), reusing linear_basis[2,30]=[ones;ramp]:
output = Einsum('nks,ns,t,ts,ta,tb,tu,tv,ar,br,uc,vc->nkrc', seq, present, term_weight,
                term_slot, ra,rb,ca,cb, linear_basis×4)
```
